title: 代码注释
problem_statement_md:
给定的代码，输出 "C++很难学"和 "C++很简单"。

清注释，仅打印"C++很简单"。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Comments[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

You are given some code, which outputs "C++ is hard" and "C++ is cool".

[h3][b]Task[/b][/h3]
[b]Comment [/b]out[b] [/b]the first line to print only "C++ is cool".

[note]Use // to comment out a line.[/note]
